lines.ja: You seem to replace your brain with your heart
lines.zh: 你似乎用你的心取代了你的大脑

lines.ja: You take things so hard and then you fall apart
lines.zh: 你把事情看得如此艰难，然后你就崩溃了

lines.ja: You try to explain, but before you can start
lines.zh: 你试图解释，但在你开始之前

lines.ja: Those "Cry baby" tears come out of the dark
lines.zh: 那些“哭泣的宝贝”的眼泪从黑暗中涌出

lines.ja: Someone's turning the handle to that faucet in your eyes
lines.zh: 有人正在转动你眼中水龙头的把手

lines.ja: You pour it out where everyone can see
lines.zh: 你把它倒在每个人都能看到的地方

lines.ja: Your heart's too big for your body, it's why it won't fit inside
lines.zh: 你的心脏对于你的身体来说太大了，这就是为什么它无法容纳进去

lines.ja: You pour it out where everyone can see
lines.zh: 你把它倒在每个人都能看到的地方

lines.ja: They call you cry baby, cry baby
lines.zh: 他们叫你哭宝贝，哭宝贝

lines.ja: So you laugh through your tears
You're all on your own and you lost all your friends
lines.zh: 你孤身一人，失去了所有的朋友

lines.ja: You told yourself that it's not you, it's them
lines.zh: 你告诉自己不是你，是他们

lines.ja: You're one of a kind and no one understands
lines.zh: 你是独一无二的，没有人理解
